segments.name: Electronics Manufacturing Services
products: printed circuit board (PCB) and complete product assembly
segments.description: Provides integrated electronic and mechanical engineering, assembly, sourcing, logistics and testing services for OEM customers.
segments.evidence: As of June 27, 2026, the Company operates and internally manages a single operating segment, Electronics Manufacturing Services, as this is the only discrete financial information that is regularly reviewed by the chief operating decision maker.

revenueModel.text: OEM customers pay the company under manufacturing service agreements and purchase orders for contract manufacturing of customer-specific products, recognized over time or upon shipment.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generally enters into manufacturing service agreements ("MSA") with its customers that outlines the terms of the business relationship between the customer and the Company.
